INFO ONLY: iteration 35.1 fix VERIFIED — mobile now correctly parses 6-digit-microsecond ISO timestamps via dayjs (`parseTimestamp` / `parseTimestampMs`) and the 30-second poll keeps the shift status/timer in sync. No 'Invalid Date' anywhere in the attendance / staff dashboard UI.
critical_code_review_comments: attendance.ts parseTimestamp fallback uses dayjs.utc(normalized).local() — good, matches RFC 3339 handling. Regex `(\.\d{3})\d+` correctly trims 6-digit fractional seconds to 3 without touching well-formed ms strings.
Both StaffDashboard and attendance.tsx wrap the poll interval in useFocusEffect — good, no leaked timers when navigating away.

attendance.tsx line 47 `useEffect(() => { refresh(); }, [refresh])` combined with `useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { refresh(); }, [refresh]))` will double-fetch on first mount + focus — harmless duplicate GET but could dedup by removing the useEffect since focus fires on mount too.
StaffDashboard.load's Promise.all fires 4 requests in parallel including the two /api/me/* endpoints that currently 404 — .catch(()=>null) handles it cleanly, no unhandled rejection.
